verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents automated retries of failed subscription and invoice payments (Smart Retries) within its revenue recovery suite. It also offers customer communications driven by Billing automations, and a Stripe PM confirmed customer emails such as card-update notices exist but are off by default. Branding is documented for invoices and the customer portal, and webhooks can handle subscription status transitions. missing for 10: evidence of configurable dunning email sequences with branding, in-app banners, grace-period settings, explicit final-state rules (cancel vs unpaid), independent hands-on corroboration.
